title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 5. Notes with deep concern the ongoing international crisis of accountability and the challenge to the pursuit of ending impunity for violations of core norms of international human rights and humanitarian law in conflicts around the world; reaffirms the neutrality and importance of humanitarian aid in all conflicts and crises; underlines the serious consequences of discrediting and attacking the organisations of multilateral forums, such as the UN, which can foster a culture of impunity and undermine the trust in and functioning of the UN system; stresses, however, that justified criticism of the inefficiency of international organisations and their failure to fulfil key responsibilities – such as ensuring security, protecting human rights and providing development aid, as exemplified by the shortcomings of the UN Security Council, the UN Human Rights Council and the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees – should serve as a basis for reflection on their functioning and potential reforms; calls for the EU to uphold the international legal system and take effective measures to enforce compliance;
